---
title: "Platforms"
subtitle: "The same benchmarks on different operating systems and architectures"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
ms <- D$machines
rel <- D$runs[D$runs$kind == "release" & D$runs$config == "default", ]
# plot the releases every machine has measured, relative to the site-wide
# baseline (newest Ubuntu LTS R) if all machines have it, else the oldest of them
start <- max(as.Date(vapply(ms$machine, function(mm) as.character(min(rel$date[rel$machine == mm])), "")))
has_base <- vapply(ms$machine, function(mm) BASELINE_VERSION %in% rel$version[rel$machine == mm], TRUE)
common_base <- if (all(has_base)) BASELINE_VERSION else rel$version[rel$date == start][1]
first_common <- rel$version[rel$date == start][1]
tls <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ms$machine, function(mm) {
  r <- rel[rel$machine == mm & rel$date >= start, ]
  timeline(D$est, r, r$run[r$version == common_base])
}))
```

```{r}
p <- plot_ly(height = 380)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ms))) {
  d <- tls[tls$machine == ms$machine[i], ]
  d <- d[order(d$date), ]
  p <- p |> add_trace(data = d, x = ~date, y = ~speedup, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
                      name = machine_label(ms$machine[i]),
                      line = list(color = SERIES[i], width = 2, shape = "hv"),
                      marker = list(color = SERIES[i], size = 7, line = list(color = LIGHT[["surface"]], width = 2)),
                      text = sprintf("%s<br>R %s: %s (n=%d)", ms$machine[i], d$version, fmt_speedup(d$speedup, 3), d$n),
                      hoverinfo = "text")
}
div(class = "rs-card",
  div(class = "rs-card-title", paste("Speedup relative to R", common_base, "on each machine")),
  div(class = "rs-card-sub", "Geomean over the benchmarks that machine ran on every release shown."),
  rs_layout(p, x = ax(NULL, type = "date"), y = speedup_axis(paste("Speedup vs R", common_base, "(×)"), tls$speedup),
            shapes = list(baseline_line()))
)
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr HAS_PROFILES
latest <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ms$machine, function(mm) {
  r <- rel[rel$machine == mm, ]
  lr <- r[which.max(r$date), ]
  pr <- D$profiles[D$profiles$run == lr$run, ]
  g <- aggregate(share ~ benchmark + group, data = pr, FUN = sum)
  g <- aggregate(share ~ group, data = g, FUN = mean)
  g$machine <- paste0(machine_label(mm), if (ms$profiles[ms$machine == mm] != "validated") " ⚠" else "")
  g
}))
div(class = "rs-card",
  div(class = "rs-card-title", "Where the time goes, by platform (latest release)"),
  div(class = "rs-card-sub", "Mean share over benchmarks. ⚠ profiler not yet validated."),
  plot_group_stack(latest, "machine", height = 260, horizontal = TRUE)
)
```

## Machines

```{r}
mt <- ms
mt$status <- vapply(mt$profiles, function(s) as.character(status(s)), "")
rs_table(
  data.frame(Machine = mt$machine, OS = mt$os, Arch = mt$arch, CPU = mt$cpu, Profiler = mt$profiler,
             Profiles = mt$status, `Measured since` = paste("R", mt$first_version), check.names = FALSE),
  columns = list(Profiles = colDef(html = TRUE)), pagination = FALSE)
```

[Machine details, sentinel history and change log →](machines.qmd)

::: {.rs-notes}
- Times from different machines are never divided by each other: that would measure the hardware, not R. Each curve starts at R `r first_common`, the oldest release every machine has measured, and is relative to R `r common_base` on the same machine.
- ⚠ marks profiles from a profiler not yet validated against perf on Linux x86-64.
:::
